In December 2024, I met Mr. Vaibhav Gadkari & we discussed my needs for detailing my Hundai i10 car.

However, when I researched the market, I found the next Generation of Car technologie was being built in India for eg. EV Platform, Flex Fuel Car platform, Hydrogen Car Platform.  From my Technology experience I understood such technologies require a longer gestation period. After careful consideration I decided to upgrade my Car and use it for the next 7 to 10 years. I thought 7 to 10 years is a good time for Car technologies to mature. After 4 years of upgrades the final step was Complete Body detailing & Painting.
2.	 I told Mr Vaibhav that I would like to use the Car for next 4 to 5 years.

4.	He mentioned that the work will be completed in 2 weeks. He gave me the assurance that he will put his best team in place, and he wanted to see a Happy customer.
As 2 weeks passed, I couldn’t see much progress and to be honest I was apprehensive of the work. Though I noticed that time was being spent on detailing efforts.
a.	The firewall portion where there was leakage was cut and replaced with a steel sheet thus shielding any leaks.
b.	Entire Car both externally and internally was polished with Sandpaper.
c.	Finally, after 4.5 weeks the work was completed.
Finally, when I went to collect my car, I was enamored by the Bosch team’s hospitality. My Car was looking like new. I felt like I was receiving a new Car from a dealer.
I decided to hold my google review until I experienced my Car in the Monsoons. On the first few showers there were no problems and my confidence grew. After nearly 1.5 months of Monsoon experience, I am highly confident of my car. I have attached the OLD and NEW pictures of my car.
